precepts.why:
This is the exhortation, like Simon’s. The sons of God are the leaders of the earth, and restoring the decayed estate of our nation begins with us. How are we going to remember when we were kings if we don’t go to it?

“When he sitteth upon the throne of his kingdom, that he shall write him a copy of this law in a book”. This is the king who sits over the kingdom, and we are kings in this building. He writes a copy of this law, not mathematics or anything like that; that wisdom is added after. We have to have this law written down. “Out of that which is before the priests the Levites”: we always had copies of our history, our archives. We had records.

“He shall read therein all the days of his life”, not every other day. That is the type of man who studies and gives you scriptures, who understands how to lead the people by exhorting them with God’s word. Those are the leaders to follow. “That he may learn to fear the Lord his God, to keep all the words of this law and these statutes, to do them”. That is the example of Judas Maccabeus and of his father, who taught his sons: that household kept the commandments and rehearsed them, because they were leaders.

“That his heart be not lifted up above his brethren, and that he turn not aside from the commandment, to the right hand, or to the left”. A man who puts himself up as a leader and does not remember his history or study lifts himself up with his own pride, unlike those humble brothers who understood a prophet had to come to know what to do.

“To the end that he may prolong his days in his kingdom”. That is where the saying long live the king comes from: the long life of a king comes from studying the commandments and keeping copies of the writing. This is the King’s code.

The War Between Blacks And Whites

points: This shows where we came from. “The ambassadors that were sent unto our people certified us of your glory and honour: wherefore we were glad of their coming”. Other nations sent ambassadors to us and honoured us.

note.label: The War Between Blacks And Whites

points: Our forefathers “did register the things that they spake in the council of the people”. We had a registry. We had a system, we had administration. We were independent at one time and governed ourselves, though at this time the Greeks were oppressing us. The Jews’ ambassadors, “Numenius son of Antiochus, and Antipater son of Jason”, came “to renew the friendship they had with us.”
So even though we are broken as a people, we had records, we had a system, we had order. The average black man doesn’t know this, because he views the Bible as a white man’s book.

note.label: The War Between Blacks And Whites

points: “The Jews and priests were well pleased that Simon should be their governor and high priest for ever, until there should arise a faithful prophet”. Simon was a leader: he was the governor and the high priest.

These men were not prideful enough to make themselves prophets. They understood they were not prophets, and there was no prophet in that time through whom the Most High was communicating to let the people know what to do. Read Kings and Chronicles: there was a king and there was a prophet, and the king consulted the prophet, as King Hezekiah consulted Isaiah. David was both a king and a prophet, and that is what makes David so unique and special, on another level.
The sisters raise their hands when asked who has read Kings and Chronicles, and the brothers who are supposed to be in the streets are looking down. The brothers have to do some reading.

note.label: The War Between Blacks And Whites

points: He was made “their captain”, to “take charge of the sanctuary, to set them over their works, and over the country, and over the armour, and over the fortresses”.

note.label: The War Between Blacks And Whites

points: “He should be obeyed of every man, and that all the writings in the country should be made in his name”. We were governing ourselves, though the Greeks were oppressing us. A lot of our brothers don’t notice this, and when they hear it they ask what Bible we are reading, because these scriptures are not read.
He was to “be clothed in purple, and wear gold”. Purple and gold are royal colors, and they are the colors of IUIC.

note.label: The War Between Blacks And Whites

points: “It should be lawful for none of the people or priests to break any of these things, or to gainsay his words, or to gather an assembly in the country without him, or to be clothed in purple, or wear a buckle of gold”.

This shows that we had order, a government, a registry, administration and records. We literally had a kingdom. Our brothers and sisters don’t know it, and that is why it is important to study. The sisters asking what they are supposed to do: don’t be a dumb woman, be reading the Bible, because the sisters in the streets need to learn.
